{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the unique values in each column
unique_counts = sales_df.nunique()

# Check the distribution of the 'converted' column
conversion_rate = sales_df['converted'].mean()

# Summary stats
summary = sales_df.describe(include='all')

missing_values, duplicates, unique_counts, conversion_rate, summary"}
